user_query: I want to fetch media from Instagram posts featuring the latest fashion trends and runway shows, and I also want to find remote job opportunities in the fashion industry.

Search for remote job opportunities in the fashion industry.
Compile and present the filtered media and remote job opportunities in an organized format.
